title: Hearty Miso Glazed Peruvian Tofu Skewers
description: A midnight-craving Peruvian dish featuring silken tofu in a miso marinate, served in agave leaves with a mustardy and glassy-jelly glaze. This dish is perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine miso paste, agave nectar, rice vinegar, Dijon mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the cubed tofu to the miso marinate and mix until the tofu is well coated.
Thread the marinated tofu onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the tofu is baking, prepare the agave leaves by rinsing them with water and patting them dry with paper towels.
After the tofu has baked for 20 minutes, brush the skewers with the remaining miso marinate and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and wrap each skewer in an agave leaf, serving immediately.
